failureMechanism: A historical successful publication/browser run is treated as a durable property of the URL even though a later independent browser session cannot reach the native first frame or any interaction.
gate: A fresh-session failure withdraws the current shareable claim for that tested environment. Historical success remains an Observation, not a current pass. Same-context reloads do not count as independent fresh-session samples.
boundaries: Does not infer a global outage or a population availability rate from one environment.
Does not prescribe a global sample count; the Mother declares the sample plan before the trial.
Does not accept a longer timeout, cache warm-up, or user retry as proof of a product fix.
